soldier: Body medium-sized. Head brownish yellow, the upper half of the mandibles dark brown and the base paler, the labrum pale brown, the antennae slightly paler than the head, the thorax, abdomen and legs yellow. Pilosity of the head sparse, with a few long setae; the anterior margin of the postmentum bears several symmetrical long or short setae; the pronotum has sparse short setae, and the setae of the abdominal tergites are long and dense. Head broadly oval, the lateral margins almost parallel, slightly broader posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly arcuate. Mandibles robust, the apex of the left mandible incurved, its tooth at one-third from the apex, the tooth apex directed antero-internally; the right mandible with a small tooth slightly behind one-third from the apex and another distinct small tooth about one-quarter from the base. Labrum lingulate, slightly narrower anteriorly, the apex bluntly rounded. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 the smallest, segment 4 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 5 slightly smaller than segment 4, the terminal segment elongate-oval. Postmentum nearly rectangular, about one and a half times as long as wide, widest near the posterior end. Pronotum saddle-shaped, with distinct notches at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.
